title: Potential at D
description: Essential: Correctly calculates φ_D = -E * d_DB, yielding -0.6 V.

title: Potential Difference C-D
description: Essential: Correctly calculates U_CD = φ_C - φ_D, yielding -4.8 V.

title: Capacitance Value
description: Essential: Correctly calculates C = Q / U_AB, yielding 1 × 10⁻⁸ F.

title: Use of Ground Reference
description: Important: Recognizes plate B is grounded (φ_B = 0) and applies it consistently for potentials.

title: Geometry for Distances
description: Important: Correctly determines distances d_DB, d_CB, and plate separation d for calculations.

title: Uniform Field Relation
description: Important: Applies Δφ = -E * Δx (with sign) for potential differences in the uniform field.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Converts all distances to meters before calculation.

title: Sign Error in Potential
description: Pitfall: Uses Δφ = +E * Δx (incorrect sign convention relative to ground/direction).

title: Plate Voltage Miscalculation
description: Pitfall: Fails to find U_AB = E*d = 6 V before calculating capacitance.
